question: When and where should the corrective offering be conveyed after the oblation?
premises: The oblation has already been performed.
The action may occur at departure time.
The action may alternatively occur at the wind-tooth direction.
inference: After performing the oblation, one should convey the offering either at departure time or at the wind-tooth point.
uncertainties: The precise technical meaning of vātadante is unclear.
plain_english: Having performed it, one should convey the offering either at the time of departure or at the wind-tooth point.
